description: Render the diagram as a PNG image, returned so you can look at it, and optionally saved to a file. Lists layout warnings (connections through nodes, overlaps, crossings) when there are any. To only refresh a preview file, set path and returnImage: false.

returnImage.description: Return the image (default true). false with a path only writes the file and answers in text.

name: diagram_export_png
title: Export PNG
